description: Write a Python data quality checking script that validates a dataset against configurable rules. The script should: (1) load a Parquet dataset, (2) apply a list of quality rules (completeness, uniqueness, range, pattern, referential integrity), (3) produce a quality report with pass/fail per rule and affected row counts, (4) optionally quarantine rows that fail critical rules, (5) return exit code 0 if all critical rules pass, 1 otherwise.
edge_cases: Completeness threshold: 95% means up to 5% NULLs are acceptable
Uniqueness check must handle NULL values (NULLs are not duplicates)
Freshness check: compare against current time, not a fixed time
Empty dataset: all rules should pass (vacuous truth) or follow config
Rule with unknown type: should warn, not crash
common_failure_modes: FM7: Completeness check counts empty strings as non-null
FM7: Uniqueness check incorrectly treats NaN as duplicate
